$schema-note: Reproducibility manifest for one unit's art. Pre-filled from art/style/ (house-style.md + prompts-units.md). Fill in sha256, seed(s), controlnet model, and handEditing after generating. See docs/art-generation.md.
role: Heavy melee tank — 1500 hp, dmg 50, range 1. The bulkiest fighter. Beats Archer, loses to Lancer (RPS triangle). The style anchor for the roster.

generation.styleFragment: soft hand-painted 2D game sprite, high-angle 3/4 top-down view, chibi proportions with large rounded head and small stout body and short stubby limbs, soft volumetric cel shading, single soft light from top-left, gentle gradient form shadows, soft ambient occlusion, crisp rim highlight, thin dark desaturated outline, cohesive muted palette of teal slate-blue warm-sand and soft-green, bold readable silhouette, cute by proportion not by expression, single character centered, transparent background, no cast ground shadow, consistent line weight, game asset, clean edges
generation.unitPrompt: a stout heavy chibi knight, big rounded dome helmet with a small plume, broad round pauldrons, a short wide armored body, soft steel plate with gentle top-left highlights, a blue tabard over the chest plate as the team color, holding a short broadsword and a small round shield, planted wide stance, a calm simple face under the helmet brim, the bulkiest tankiest unit
generation.teamColorZone: blue tabard + shield face (double the team zone; generate master in blue key, recolor per team)
generation.negativePrompt: side view, front orthographic view, flat orthographic, isometric grid, realistic human proportions, tall lanky body, heavy black comic ink outline, cel-shaded anime, harsh cast shadow on ground, busy background, scenery, multiple characters, text, watermark, signature, logo, oversaturated neon colors, gradient background, photorealistic, 3d render, blurry, low contrast, extra limbs, deformed hands, exaggerated screaming face, bulging eyes, hard angular armor slabs, bare muscular barbarian
generation.seed: FILL_IN — record the winning seed (this is the house anchor; lock it first)

controlnet.poses: art/units/warrior/poses/  (OpenPose skeletons, one per frame, posed from a high 3/4 angle)

attack.note: signature action: big overhead sword chop

handEditing: FILL_IN — describe any manual cleanup/compositing done.
deployedTo: UnityRTS/RTS/Assets/... (path where the finished sheet is imported into Unity)
notes: Widest/heaviest of the three fighters — soft rounded plate, NOT hard angular slabs and NOT bare barbarian muscle (both tried and rejected). This unit sets the house style; lock its seed/LoRA first, then generate the others to match.
